en: The image shows an old waterfront scene with many boats and ships docked in a harbor. The view is depicted in vintage, muted colors typical of early colorized postcards. There is busy port activity with carts and people visible along the dock. In the background, there are hills or low mountains across the water. The postcard has inscriptions in both Greek and French at the top and a watermark with a website at the bottom.
